reviewNotice: This is an in-progress paper kit. Section 6 is completely triaged: ten numbered items provisionally match, while the n=2 statements in Lemma 6.8(iv) and Theorem 6.2 are directly refuted by an independently audited, nonvacuous actual 2-ADC counterexample. The same omitted class refutes the binary Theorem 1.9(ii) and changes Theorem 1.10 from +1 to +2; an exact corrected six-family catalogue is proved. Theorem 7.1 is proved, but its printed proof omits that class. Section 7 has 19/21 fully formalized numbered items; Corollary 7.21 has an exact catalogue and maximal partition, with residue-norm formulas conditional on O'Meara 63:9. Lemma 7.13 has a printed quantifier mismatch. Every numbered deduction in Sections 5 and 8, plus Theorems 1.5 and 1.7, is proved from explicit law packages, but their concrete non-dyadic and number-field instances remain pending. Reports 26-49 give the scope. The exact clean Review Kit for 85772de passes a fresh 5,047-job build, the three He ADC audits, and the 60,152-declaration enforcing gate. GitHub-hosted CI and artifact upload, remaining arithmetic instances and enumeration, release promotion, and human sign-off remain separate gates.
